descriptionFromApi:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior AI Evaluation Reliability Engineer who is passionate about solving one of the most important challenges in AI: How do we know an AI system is actually working, improving, and delivering business value. You will design and build production-grade evaluation systems for LLMs, RAG applications, and multi-agent systems, while helping enterprise clients and our engineering teams adopt AI with confidence.

This role goes beyond building evals. You will be a trusted AI consultant to clients, a technical mentor to engineers, and a key contributor to our journey towards becoming an AI superagency.

What You Will Own

  • Make AI Performance ROI Measurable: Build evaluation strategies that connect AI performance to business outcomes and ROI.
  • Define quality benchmarks, SLOs, risk thresholds, and success criteria.
  • Track hallucinations, reliability issues, and production risks.
  • Build executive-friendly AI quality and ROI scorecards.
  • Help clients determine where AI should be autonomous, supervised, or avoided.
  • Don't just measure model accuracy. Measure business impact.

Build Production-Grade Evaluation Pipelines

  • Architect automated evaluation pipelines for LLMs, RAG, and agentic systems.
  • Integrate evaluations into CI/CD using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
  • Build regression suites for prompts, models, tools, and workflows.
  • Measure faithfulness, context precision, answer relevance, semantic drift, and task completion.
  • Establish statistically meaningful benchmarks and continuously monitor AI quality.
  • Evaluation should become part of engineering, not a final QA step.

Engineer LLM-as-a-Judge Systems

  • Design reference-based and reference-free LLM evaluation frameworks.
  • Create structured rubrics and scoring systems.
  • Build calibration loops using human-labelled datasets.
  • Identify and mitigate judge biases such as position, verbosity, and self-preference bias.
  • Measure judge reliability and optimize evaluation quality, latency, and cost.

Own Evaluation Economics

  • LLM evaluations can become expensive quickly.
  • You will: Design tiered evaluation strategies.
  • Use deterministic and heuristic graders for simple checks.
  • Reserve powerful LLM judges for complex evaluations.
  • Optimise batching, concurrency, and parallel execution.
  • Track evaluation cost and balance quality, latency, and inference spend.

Benchmark RAG Agentic Systems

  • Build systematic benchmarks across:
  • Retrieval quality, faithfulness, and answer relevance
  • Embedding, chunking and re-ranking strategies
  • Vector databases and retrieval architectures
  • Agent task completion and tool-calling accuracy
  • State retention, multi-step workflows and failure recovery
  • Latency, reliability and cost
  • Build synthetic datasets, golden test suites, and adversarial scenarios to continuously expand evaluation coverage.

Be a Trusted AI Consultant

  • You will work directly with North American enterprise clients as a technical AI advisor.
  • You will: Lead AI architecture and evaluation discussions.
  • Translate complex AI metrics into clear business recommendations.
  • Define AI quality, reliability, and risk frameworks.
  • Present evaluation telemetry and ROI scorecards to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Challenge assumptions and recommend the right AI solution, even when that means saying "don't use AI here."
  • You should be equally comfortable discussing LLM evaluation with engineers and ROI with a CTO/COO/CEO/CFO.

Drive AI Consulting Presales

Your consulting mindset will extend beyond delivery. You will actively participate in presales and new business opportunities, helping us win strategic AI engagements with enterprise clients.

  • Participate in discovery calls, solution workshops, and technical discussions with prospective clients.
  • Understand client challenges and identify where AI, agents, RAG, or automation can create meaningful business value.
  • Shape AI solution approaches, evaluation strategies, and technical proposals.
  • Contribute to statements of work, estimates, solution architectures, and project proposals.
  • Build compelling technical narratives and demonstrations that showcase our AI capabilities.
  • Present AI solutions and recommendations to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Help identify opportunities to expand existing engagements through new AI capabilities.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Engineering teams to convert opportunities into successful engagements.

Role Summary

This is an India-based global role supporting Amgen''s global obesity business. The Senior Manager, Data Enablement will own the data foundation that enables analytics, products, AI, and decision-making to move at the speed of the business.

The mission is simple: analytical teams should spend their time solving business problems - not searching for data, reconciling inconsistencies, or rebuilding datasets for every new question. This is not a traditional data management role. It requires technical depth, business judgment, and an appreciation for how high-quality, well-governed data accelerates decisions across the organization.

This leader will own Obesity data readiness. In close partnership with enterprise data and technology teams, the role will ensure the data ecosystem meets business needs by making datasets business-ready and AI-ready, while influencing priorities so analytics can move at the pace the business requires. Success depends on balancing speed with governance, aligning data with enterprise architecture, privacy, security, and quality standards, and keeping it fit for rapidly evolving business needs.

Success is measured by how quickly new questions can be answered, how confidently teams trust the data they use, and how effectively the organization can scale analytics, AI-enabled solutions, and future products without data becoming the constraint.

Key Responsibilities


1. Data Readiness Agenda Use-Case Prioritization

  • Own the data readiness agenda supporting priority obesity analytics, products, AI/ML, reporting, and decision-support use cases.
  • Partner with analytics, product, commercial, scientific, operations, and technology teams to understand data needs before analytical work begins.
  • Convert ambiguous requests into clear data requirements, source plans, readiness criteria, quality expectations, and delivery commitments.
  • Prioritize data work based on business value, reuse potential, urgency, governance requirements, quality risk, and downstream analytical impact.

2. Data Onboarding, Integration Business-Ready Preparation

  • Lead onboarding of internal and external sources required for analytics products, business intelligence, AI/ML, and future decision-support tools.
  • Coordinate sourcing, access, mapping, integration, transformation, testing, and handoff so datasets can be used reliably by downstream teams.
  • Work with enterprise data and engineering partners to align pipelines, curated layers, refresh patterns, and access models with platform direction.
  • Resolve practical data issues that slow teams down, including mismatched definitions, missing fields, unclear ownership, inconsistent granularity, and usability gaps.

3. Data Quality, Controls Issue Resolution

  • Establish quality checks, validation rules, issue logs, remediation processes, escalation paths, and sign-off expectations for priority data assets.
  • Identify recurring defects, root causes, control gaps, and ownership breakdowns, then drive fixes that prevent the same problems from returning.
  • Create practical standards for reconciliation, refresh monitoring, exception handling, data stability, and known limitation management.
  • Partner with source owners, technology teams, vendors, and business users to resolve problems quickly, transparently, and with clear accountability.
  • Protect analytical credibility. If the data is weak, unclear, late, or unstable, teams should know before insights, products, or models depend on it.

4. Reusable Data Products, Documentation AI-Ready Assets

  • Build reusable data products, semantic layers, standardized business rules, and documentation that improve consistency and reduce repeated manual work.
  • Define and maintain metadata, lineage, data dictionaries, transformation logic, ownership, refresh expectations, known limitations, and usage guidance.
  • Enable self-service where appropriate, while keeping controls strong enough for regulated healthcare data and sensitive business information.
  • Make reuse easy. Every high-value dataset should become easier for the next team to understand, trust, apply, and extend.

5. Governance, Compliance Enterprise Partnership

  • Partner with privacy, security, legal, compliance, architecture, and enterprise data teams to ensure responsible data use.
  • Translate governance requirements into practical ways of working that teams can follow without unnecessary friction or delay.
  • Support appropriate access management, documentation, retention expectations, vendor coordination, data-use controls, and audit readiness.
  • Represent obesity intelligence data needs clearly with enterprise technology partners, bridging gaps between policy, platform direction, and analytical reality.

6. Team Leadership, Service Model Capability Building

  • Lead an India-based data enablement team that provides disciplined, responsive support to analytics, products, and AI/ML use cases.
  • Create a service model for intake, triage, delivery, documentation, quality checks, issue resolution, stakeholder communication, and ongoing support.
  • Coach team members to combine technical rigor with business understanding, customer-service orientation, and ownership of downstream impact.
  • Set clear expectations for responsiveness, documentation, reuse, quality, transparency, and practical problem solving.

  • Master''s degree and 8+ years of relevant experience; OR

  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling reusable, governed data assets that improved analytical speed, consistency, data quality, or organizational reuse.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
The Manager- Privacy Engineering Data Protection Compliance sits within the Data Privacy Office (DPO), part of Equinixs Legal organisation, and is responsible for ensuring that data protection and privacy obligations are effectively implemented and operationalised across systems, processes, and business operations.
This role is technical and delivery-focused and will serve as a critical link between the Data Privacy Office (DPO), the Digital Innovation Organization (DIO) (particularly Information Security (InfoSec)), and other business functions across Equinix.
The successful candidate will:
  • Work with the DPO to translate legal and regulatory requirements into actionable technical and operational solutions
  • Support and drive the embedding of privacy-by-design, data governance, and AI governance into technology and business processes
  • Enable the development of scalable frameworks, controls, and tools to support compliance
  • Contribute to ongoing monitoring, KPI tracking, and audit-readiness of privacy and data protection controls
This role will act as the bridge between legal and technical teams to ensure that regulatory requirements are implemented in a practical, measurable, and sustainable way, enabling both compliance and innovation.
Responsibilities
Privacy Engineering, Compliance Implementation
  • Work with DPO to translate regulatory and legal requirements (e.g. GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, India DPDP Act, China PIPL, and other global privacy laws) into technical controls, system requirements, and operational processes
  • Lead and/or contribute to the design, creation, and continuous refinement of privacy, data protection, and security-related processes, standards, and policies to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and operational needs
  • Support and drive implementation of Privacy by Design across products, platforms, and internal systems
  • Partner with engineering, InfoSec, and product teams to embed privacy requirements into system architecture, development lifecycles, and operational workflows
  • Define, implement, and maintain technical and organisational measures (TOMs) aligned to legal obligations
  • Conduct and support hands-on technical evaluations, including: data flow analysis, system and architecture reviews, privacy impact/risk assessments
  • Contribute to the development of standardised patterns, guardrails, and reusable solutions for privacy compliance
Data Governance Lifecycle Management
  • Support and help drive implementation of data governance frameworks, including: data lifecycle management, data classification
  • Partner with business and technical teams to map data flows, processing activities, and system dependencies
  • Support development and simplification of operational controls
  • Enable consistent implementation of data handling standards across the enterprise
Data Security
  • Partner with InfoSec to ensure privacy requirements are embedded within data security controls and practices
  • Support compliance alignment with security frameworks and standards (e.g. ISO 27001, NIST)
  • Contribute to third-party risk management, vendor onboarding, and data security reviews
  • Support implementation of privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g. data masking, minimisation)
AI Governance Responsible Data Use
  • Support and help drive implementation of AI governance frameworks, including policies, controls, and risk management practices
  • Translate legal and regulatory requirements relating to AI and automated decision-making into operational controls and guidance
  • Support responsible and compliant use of personal data in AI systems
  • Contribute to development of training, FAQs, and business guidance for AI usage
Data Privacy Program Enablement (Operationalisation)
  • Support and contribute to implementation of the organisations data privacy compliance program, including: privacy policies, standards, and procedures, data protection impact assessments (DPIAs)
  • Support responses to customer, vendor, and regulatory data protection queries
Incident Management Regulatory Support
  • Support privacy incident management processes, including coordination with cybersecurity teams
  • Contribute to incident assessments, escalation processes, and regulatory reporting inputs
  • Help define and refine roles, responsibilities, and handoffs between privacy and security incident processes
  • Support continuous improvement of incident response frameworks
Stakeholder Engagement Collaboration
  • Work closely with Legal, InfoSec, DIO, HR, Procurement, and other business functions across Equinix to support implementation of privacy requirements
  • Act as a translator between legal, technical, and business teams, ensuring clarity and alignment
  • Build strong working relationships to enable consistent and scalable adoption of privacy controls
  • Communicate risks, trade-offs, and priorities effectively across stakeholders
Tools, Automation, Monitoring Continuous Improvement
  • Support use and optimisation of privacy and compliance tools (e.g. OneTrust, ServiceNow)
  • Help design and implement monitoring, KPI tracking, and reporting frameworks to measure effectiveness of privacy controls
  • Contribute to development of audit-ready processes and evidence frameworks aligned to regulatory expectations
  • Drive continuous improvement of key processes, including privacy assessments
  • Identify and incorporate lessons learned from incidents, audits, and operational issues to continuously improve processes, controls, and documentation
  • Support automation and scalability of compliance operations
Qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience in technical privacy / privacy engineering, technology risk, compliance, or information security
  • Demonstrated experience working across legal, technical, and business domains
  • Experience supporting or implementing privacy and data protection programs
  • Experience developing and refining processes and documentation based on lessons learned

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

We are looking for a Strategic Talent Acquisition Manager with 8-10 years of experience who can own, lead, and drive our entire recruitment engine. This is an executive-interfacing role where you will manage a team of recruiters, act as a talent consultant to the C-suite, and run a highly data-driven TA operation. You must be skilled at translating raw recruiting data into executive-ready performance metrics and business outcomes for management.

Responsibilities

  • C-Suite Stakeholder Management: Partner directly with the CEO, Founders, and C-level executives to forecast headcount needs, calibrate senior mandates, and align talent acquisition with long-term business strategy.
  • Team Leadership Velocity: Manage, mentor, and monitor a team of 3-5 TA specialists; execute weekly performance reviews to optimize team throughput, pipeline generation, and time-to-hire velocity.
  • Data-Driven TA Governance: Build and maintain recruiting dashboards inside the ATS; track, audit, and analyse comprehensive recruitment metrics (e.g., pipeline conversions, source-mix cost, and funnel drop-off rates).
  • Executive Presentation Reporting: Synthesize complex recruiting datasets into structured, high-level business presentations for the leadership team to review hiring velocity, market talent intelligence, and quarter-on-quarter ROI.
  • Sourcing Framework Design: Architect advanced Inbound Outbound sourcing strategies across premium channels (LinkedIn Recruiter, Wellfound, premium networks) to ensure a steady pipeline for critical management and engineering mandates.

Must-Have Requirements (Strict Binary Filters)

  • Experience Range: Exactly 8-10 years of core experience in corporate Talent Acquisition or Recruitment functions.
  • C-Suite Advisory History: Minimum 3 years of experience directly advising, reporting to, and managing hiring expectations for C-level executives (CEOs, CTOs, CFOs).
  • Industry Domain: Minimum 4 years of in-house corporate TA experience within a B2B SaaS, Cloud Technology, CPaaS, or fast-scaling tech-product company.
  • Leadership Span: Minimum 3 years of direct people-management experience, having managed an internal team of at least 3 recruiters (excluding outsourced RPO or external vendors).
  • Technical Stack Analytics: Advanced proficiency with enterprise ATS platforms (Zoho Recruit, Greenhouse, or Lever) and executive dashboard building using data tools (Excel Pivot Tables, Tableau, or PowerBI).
  • Logistical Constraint: 100% comfortable with a full-time, on-site work structure in Noida and a maximum notice period of 30 days.

Good-to-Have Requirements

  • Experience managing executive search pipelines for VP and C-level leadership positions.
  • AI-Driven Recruitment Trends: Hands-on exposure to leveraging Generative AI and advanced automation layers within the recruitment stack (e.g., AI-powered resume screening agents, utilised LLMs for precision candidate outbound prompt writing, and tech-driven candidate assessment engines).
  • Experience designing and scaling structured internal employee referral programs that contribute over 30% of total organization hires.

This Profile Is NOT For

  • Industry Mismatch: Candidates coming from traditional non-tech sectors such as Manufacturing, FMCG, Retail, Hospitality, Infrastructure, or Real Estate.
  • Agency-Only/Search Firm Profiles: Candidates who have only worked on the agency/consultancy side without sustained, in-house corporate TA ownership.
  • Pure Execution Coordinators: Individuals who only execute tactical resume sorting and scheduling rather than owning data architecture, strategy, and business reporting.

Who we are

Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform that combines on-the-job learning and deal execution to drive behavior change and get more revenue per rep. Mindtickle is recognized as a market leader by top industry analysts and is ranked by G2 as the #1 sales onboarding and training product.
Our commitment to innovation has also earned us the "AI-based Sales Solution of the Year" award in the 8th annual AI Breakthrough Awards program ( PR Newswire) , and a Gold Stevie Award for Sales and Customer Service ( Mindtickle )- recognition of our dedication to both product excellence and outstanding customer support.

Job Snapshot

Mindtickle is hiring a Group Product Manager to own Behavior Intelligence and Performance Intelligence - the AI that turns the signals about a sales rep (calls, role plays, assessments, CRM activity) into insight on how each rep performs, and the products that put that insight in front of frontline managers and revenue leaders.

The problem is hard in a specific way. "Is this rep good at discovery" has no correct answer sitting in a table, and the output is a judgment about a person that a manager or CFO will challenge. You will decide what counts as correct, get customers to agree with it, and defend it. The role spans deep AI product work on one side and senior revenue leaders as your users on the other.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You own the charter end to end: product direction, roadmap, customer relationships, and business outcomes.

Whats in it for you

Product ownership

  • Own the Behavior Intelligence roadmap: the insight the platform builds about each rep, and how that insight stays current and trustworthy.

  • Define and build the Performance Intelligence products that put that insight in front of frontline managers and revenue leaders, grounded in what those users are trying to get done.

  • Decide what a correct judgment about a rep looks like, and earn customer acceptance of it.

  • Hold a product direction anchored in customer outcomes. When the platform is behind it, find the path that still lands value and push the platform toward the gap.

Customer and market ownership

  • Represent the product externally: pre-sales conversations, escalations, and hard customer conversations, without a safety net.

  • Find and run design partnerships with senior revenue leaders. Come back from those conversations with decisions.

  • Build conviction for new product bets ahead of the data, and be right often enough that the org keeps backing them.

Business ownership

  • Inform and consult on pricing, packaging, and revenue for the products you own.

  • Hold a view on those calls and argue it, in terms of what it does to the deal.

AI-native ways of working

  • Run evals as the improvement loop: action-based evaluation, error analysis, and observability on what the system does in production.

  • Prototype several paths through a problem in hours instead of debating which one is right.

  • Work with agents running on your own work, and critically review what the model produces.

Wed love to hear from you, if you have:

  • 8+ years of experience, including 5+ years managing technology products (ideally B2B SaaS).

  • A track record of shipping substantial products fast, at quality, with small teams

  • Experience running an eval discipline for an AI or LLM-based product in production.

  • Range across altitudes: you can argue eval design with engineers and hold a churn conversation with a CRO in the same week.

  • Evidence of external ownership: hard customer conversations you ran alone, and what changed because of them.

  • A working style already built around AI: agents configured on your own repos and research, fast prototyping, critical review of model output.

Preferred Experience

  • Sales enablement or revenue intelligence: you know what a CRO does with call data and what a frontline manager does on Monday morning.

  • Or the equivalent structure: a data-heavy B2B product sold to a business operator in a revenue or marketing org, where the buyer and the configurer were different people.

  • Building AI products that make judgments people must accept - rankings, recommendations, or automated decisions with no human review.

Our culture accolades
As an organization, it s our priority to create a highly engaging and rewarding workplace. We offer tons of awesome perks and many opportunities for growth.
Our culture reflects our employees globally diverse backgrounds along with our commitment to our customers, and each other, and a passion for excellence. We live up to our values, DAB, Delight your customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. What youll do...
About Team:

The role combines people leadership, architecture, engineering excellence, product delivery, and AI-first development practices .

Who we are.

The ideal candidate is a strong technology leader who can translate business and product requirements into scalable technical solutions, make sound architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and drive teams toward high-quality and predictable delivery.

A key expectation of this role is to champion AI-first software development , enabling engineering teams to leverage AI across the development lifecycle while maintaining high standards of quality, security, reliability, and maintainability.

Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership Architecture
  • Provide strong technical leadership and direction across the engineering team, while remaining sufficiently hands-on to guide complex technical decisions.
  • Design, develop, and scale complex, high-performance systems using appropriate architectural patterns for both horizontal and vertical scalability.
  • Own and influence architectural decisions, technical strategy, technology choices, and engineering standards.
  • Translate product and business requirements into clear technical plans, architecture, milestones, and execution strategies .
  • Evaluate technical trade-offs across scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and time-to-market.
  • Identify opportunities for modernization, simplification, automation, and technology adoption .
AI-First Engineering
  • Establish and champion AI-first software development practices across the engineering organization.
  • Drive the effective use of LLMs and AI-powered development tools across the software lifecycle - including requirements analysis, architecture, coding, code modernization, testing, debugging, documentation, code reviews, and knowledge discovery .
  • Establish engineering best practices for using AI while maintaining appropriate standards for code quality, security, privacy, reliability, and architectural integrity .
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and intelligent automation to significantly improve developer productivity, engineering velocity, and software quality .
  • Encourage experimentation with emerging AI technologies and help the team move successful experiments into reliable production solutions.
People Leadership
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers.
  • Establish a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning, technical excellence, and collaboration .
  • Provide regular technical and career mentorship and help engineers grow into increasingly larger responsibilities.
  • Participate in hiring, team building, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Create an environment where engineers are empowered to make decisions while maintaining strong technical and delivery standards.
Engineering Excellence Delivery
  • Drive engineering teams toward predictable, high-quality delivery while maintaining a strong focus on quality, reliability, and customer impact .
  • Establish and continuously improve development practices around code quality, unit testing, automated testing, Git, CI/CD, code reviews, and release management .
  • Work effectively within Agile/Scrum development processes and continuously improve team execution.
  • Identify and remove technical, organizational, and process bottlenecks that impact engineering velocity.
  • Establish appropriate metrics and mechanisms to improve engineering productivity, quality, reliability, and delivery predictability .
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Architecture, DevOps, Security, Data, and other engineering teams to deliver high-impact products and capabilities.
  • Communicate technical decisions, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and delivery plans clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term architectural and engineering investments.
  • Take ownership of ambiguous and complex problems and drive them to resolution.

What youll do how youll make your mark.

Technical Expertise

Strong experience with modern web and software engineering technologies, including several of the following:

  • Frontend: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React, Redux, Redux Middleware, React Hooks, Next.js
  • Backend: Java, PHP, Go, Python, Node.js, or equivalent backend technologies

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life You will be closely work with engineering leadership, systems engineering, product management, and cross functional teams to drive architectural decisions, design reviews, and engineering best practices. As a recognized technical authority, the Senior Principal Engineer mentors senior engineers and technical leads, drives innovation, reduces architectural complexity and technical debt, and ensures that quality, testability, and regulatory compliance are built into the system by design within an agile, fast changing development environment.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

  • Architect and design secure, scalable, and innovative solutions for desktop, web, and mobile platforms, often developing systems from the ground up.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to ensure solutions meet business objectives and comply with FDA, ISO, and other regulatory standards.
  • Collaborate closely with local development and test leads, as well as the Cardiac Ablation Solutions Operating Unit (CAS OU) Development Architect, to align on technical strategies, design decisions, and implementation plans.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence.
  • Solve complex technical challenges, address system-wide issues, and deliver high-quality, high-performance, scalable solutions.
  • Ensure adherence to relevant regulations (e. g. , FDA, IEC 62304) and maintain compliance with quality processes throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with RD teams across product lines to align technical strategies with business goals and enable smooth integration of systems and technologies.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and industry trends, incorporating relevant advancements into products and processes to drive innovation.
  • Contribute to iterative development cycles within Agile/Scrum environments, ensuring adherence to Agile principles and best practices.

Required Knowledge and Experience:

  • Minimum 18 years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in architecting, designing, and developing solutions for desktop, web, and mobile platforms.
  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master s or PhD preferred).
  • Proven experience as the lead architect / principal designer for at least two end-to-end software development projects (Windows desktop or mobile applications).
  • Extensive experience developing medical devices and working within regulated environments.
  • Strong expertise in enterprise architecture, including microservices, advanced API development, scalable system design, and integration strategies for complex, high-performance applications.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership, team management, and strong communication/interpersonal skills.
  • Experience collaborating with global, distributed teams.
  • Expertise in Python, C++ and C#, with proficiency in additional languages such as Java, etc.
  • Proficiency in modern UI/UX frameworks and technologies: React, Angular, WPF, Qt.
  • Strong command of design patterns and architectural best practices.
  • Experience with design and modeling tools such as Enterprise Architect, IBM Rhapsody, etc.
  • Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience building native and hybrid mobile applications.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Understanding of FDA regulations, ISO standards, and global regulatory requirements for medical devices and healthcare systems.
  • Knowledge of emerging technologies: AI/ML, IoT, AR/VR within healthcare.
  • Certifications in enterprise architecture (e. g. , TOGAF), cloud technologies (e. g. , AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Expert), or regulatory compliance (e. g. , RAC).

  • Data Standards: Solid understanding and working experience with XML / XSD data structures.

descriptionFromApi:
Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevSecOps & Cloud Engineer with extensive experience in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise DevOps platforms, cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in GitHub Actions, Jenkins Shared Libraries, GitHub Enterprise migrations, Terraform, AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory or Nexus Repository Manager, and automation using Python and Shell scripting.

The successful candidate will architect secure, scalable, and automated delivery pipelines, standardize CI/CD frameworks, integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle, and lead cloud transformation initiatives. Working closely with Engineering, Security, and Platform teams, this role will drive DevSecOps best practices, enhance developer productivity, improve software quality, and mentor engineers in building modern, resilient, and efficient cloud platforms.
What you will do:

CI/CD Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins Shared Libraries.
  • Build reusable workflows, shared libraries, composite actions, automation templates, and standardized CI/CD frameworks.
  • Optimize pipeline performance through matrix builds, caching, concurrency controls, artifact management, and workflow enhancements.
  • Lead and execute migrations from legacy source control and CI/CD platforms to GitHub Enterprise.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

  • Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning using Terraform across AWS and/or Azure environments.
  • Integrate infrastructure provisioning seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Maintain scalable, secure, and version-controlled infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices.

DevSecOps & Security

  • Embed security-by-design principles throughout the CI/CD lifecycle.
  • Implement automated SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, license compliance, and vulnerability management.
  • Secure secrets using GitHub Secrets, OIDC, and cloud-native secret management solutions.
  • Configure and maintain SonarQube for code quality governance and technical debt management.
  • Enforce deployment approvals, environment protection rules, and release governance.

Platform Engineering & Automation

  • Design, deploy, and manage self-hosted GitHub Runners, including Kubernetes-based Actions Runner Controller (ARC).
  • Manage and optimize artifact repositories using JFrog Artifactory or Nexus Repository Manager.
  • Develop automation solutions using Python and Shell scripting to improve operational efficiency.
  • Optimize build infrastructure for scalability, reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot complex CI/CD pipeline failures, deployment issues, and infrastructure challenges.

Technical Leadership

  • Define and enforce enterprise CI/CD standards, Git workflows, YAML best practices, and branching strategies.
  • Mentor developers and DevOps engineers on modern DevOps, automation, and platform engineering practices.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Security, and Platform teams to continuously improve software delivery processes.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging DevOps tools, cloud technologies, and automation best practices aligned with business objectives.
Qualifications & Skills:
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. A Masters degree is an added advantage.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in DevSecOps, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Software Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong expertise in designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins Shared Libraries.
  • Hands-on experience building reusable workflows, composite actions, shared libraries, automation templates, and standardized CI/CD frameworks.
  • Proven experience leading migrations from legacy source control and CI/CD platforms (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI) to GitHub Enterprise.
  • Strong experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), integrating infrastructure provisioning into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms and cloud-native services supporting CI/CD and DevOps workflows.
  • Experience implementing DevSecOps best practices, including SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, license compliance, secrets management, and secure deployment governance.
  • Experience managing and optimizing artifact repositories using JFrog Artifactory or Nexus Repository Manager.
  • Experience configuring and maintaining SonarQube for code quality analysis, governance, and technical debt management.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for automation and tooling, with working knowledge of Bash/Shell scripting.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including managed platforms such as Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, or Google GKE.
  • Expert knowledge of Git, including branching strategies, GitFlow, Trunk-Based Development, and repository management.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex CI/CD, infrastructure, and cloud platform issues.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, mentoring, and technical leadership skills.
Preferred Skills:
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional or equivalent cloud certification.
  • GitHub Actions, GitHub Administration, Kubernetes, Terraform, or related DevOps certifications.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD governance, release management, and software delivery best practices.

Role & responsibilities


Principal GenAI Solution Architect(MERN & Azure)

Experience: 8+ Years

Job Summary

Principal GenAI Solution Architect with 8+ years of experience to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grad Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in full-stack application architecture using the MERN stack, cloud-native development on Azure, and modern AI technologies including AI Agents, RAG, and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

Required Skills

  • 1516 years of experience in software development and solution architecture with expertise in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js).
  • Strong experience in designing scalable enterprise applications using microservices, REST APIs, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI solutions, AI-powered workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Azure, Azure AI services, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of system integration, security, application performance, and enterprise architecture best practices.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to mentor technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise-grade GenAI solutions using the MERN stack and Azure Cloud.
  • Analyse business requirements and translate them into scalable, secure, and high-performance technical solutions.
  • Design and integrate AI-powered capabilities, MCP-based workflows, and enterprise integrations across applications.
  • Provide technical leadership by driving architecture reviews, technology decisions, and engineering best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical challenges and ensure successful solution delivery.
  • Mentor engineering teams, establish architectural standards, and continuously evaluate emerging technologies to enhance business solutions.

jobDescription:
Hiring MLOps Engineers for Part Time / Freelancer Role (Work from Home) @ Techgene Solutions Pvt Ltd  
 
Company : Techgene Solutions Pvt Ltd (www.techgene.com)  
Experience :  8 to 20 Years.  
Role  :  MLOps Engineer – Freelancer / Part Time Opportunity
Duration : 6 Months
Job Mode : Freelancer
Job Timings  :  3 PM to 12 AM - IST  
Mode of Work :  Work from Home – Permanent
Mandate Skills   :  MLOps, AWS, Python, Gen AI,Sagemaker,Bedrock 
 
JOB PROFILE:

 We are Hiring MLOPs Engineers with around 08 to 20 Years of experience.  
 Must have Deep hands-on AWS SageMaker experience (Pipelines, Model Registry, Processing/Training Jobs, Endpoints, Model Monitor, Spot training)
 Proven capability with Amazon Bedrock model deployments, large language model evaluation, prompt versioning, and GenAI monitoring
 Strong Python programming and automation (boto3, sagemaker SDK, pandas/polars)
 Proficient with AWS ML services (Glue, S3, ECR, CloudWatch, Step Functions), Docker/container engineering, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline)
 Experience building scalable ML pipelines, container registries, and model rollout/rollback automation
 Familiarity with infrastructure as code (AWS CDK/CloudFormation), reproducibility patterns, and security/compliance best practices (HIPAA, PHI)
 Excellent collaboration skills, systems thinking, attention to detail, and a commitment to engineering excellence
 Healthcare/regulated experience and ML observability background preferred
 Experience with FHIR/HL7, PyTorch, HuggingFace, open-source contributions, or AWS certifications (Machine Learning Specialty, Solutions Architect, or DevOps Engineer).
